build_sinusoidal_positional_embedding: build a SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding module with a given embedding dimension and padding index
create_get_embedding: create sinusoidal embeddings for a specified number of embeddings and embedding dimension
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding with input tensor of size bsz by seqlen
prepare_onnx_export: prepare the SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding module for ONNX export by enabling onnx_trace mode
test_incremental_decoding: test incremental state decoding with a specified timestep for single step generation
